name: DTCCCANO Derivative SD 1 V 03
definition: The DTCCCANODerivativeSD1 message extends ISO corporate action notification (CANO) message with DTCC corporate action derivative notice elements not covered in the standard message.

CorporateActionNotification.name: Corporate Action Notification
CorporateActionNotification.definition: Extension block for the information to be extended as corporate action notification details.
